name: coordlane
description: Dispatch isolated Codex tasks and deliver one-shot Crew completion wakes without polling.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch isolated tasks and wake the Captain.
interface.longDescription: A small Codex coordination plugin for assignment delivery, linked-worktree isolation, Captain-owned write scopes, explicit durable completion, and one-shot result wakes without polling.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Coordlane Core to register these tasks and dispatch isolated work with explicit write paths.
